Add a dark mode toggle to the header of the docs site so that readers who work at night stop getting glare. It is just a toggle; it owns the theme choice and nothing else. Done when the toggle flips light and dark in under 200 ms and the choice survives a reload. For example, the reader opens the Install page at night, clicks the toggle, and the page recolors. First the reader clicks the toggle, then the page recolors and the choice is saved. Not per-page themes, and never change the saved light theme. "Dark" means the palette in tokens.css. Per-page themes can come later. I am assuming the site has no dark palette yet; verify that first. If the reader has dark mode set in their browser and no saved choice, then the page should start dark.
